label: ICR-3231 industrial LTE router
description: DIN-rail LTE Cat 4 router/gateway with two independent 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports (ETH0, ETH1), one RS-232 and one RS-485 serial port, and digital I/O. Dual SIM for carrier failover, Linux-based ICR-OS with NAT, firewall and VPN; Wi-Fi and GNSS are optional modules, not fitted on the base model.
